title: CrossModalQA: A Cross-modal and Multi-hop Benchmark for Multimodal Retrieval-augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.05518v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite the strong capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), their parametric knowledge remains incomplete and difficult to update, motivating multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to ground responses in external text and images. However, existing benchmarks face two major limitations: (i) they typically emphasize single-hop retrieval or reasoning over a small set of provided contexts rather than open-domain evidence discovery; and (ii) they provide fragmented coverage of cross-modal reasoning paths, leaving complex multi-hop and multi-image reasoning underexplored. In this paper, we introduce CrossModalQA, an open-domain benchmark for evaluating multimodal retrieval and reasoning over heterogeneous corpora. translated_title: CrossModalQA：面向多模态检索增强生成的跨模态多跳基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.05518v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLM）具有强大的能力，但其参数化知识仍然不完整且难以更新，这促使人们提出多模态检索增强生成（RAG），以将回答建立在外部文本和图像的基础上。然而，现有基准测试面临两个主要局限：（i）它们通常强调单跳检索或对少量给定上下文的推理，而非开放域证据发现；（ii）它们对跨模态推理路径的覆盖较为零散，使得复杂的多跳和多图像推理仍未得到充分探索。在本文中，我们提出了CrossModalQA，一个用于评估异构语料库上多模态检索与推理的开放域基准。CrossModalQA包含1,863个问答对，由4,987篇维基百科文章和4,431张维基共享资源图像构建而成。它涵盖五种互补的推理路径：视觉到文本、文本到视觉等。
tldr: 提出了CrossModalQA，一个由数千篇维基百科文章和图像构建的开放域跨模态多跳基准，用于系统评估多模态检索增强生成中的检索与推理能力。
en_tdlr: CrossModalQA is an open-domain cross-modal multi-hop benchmark with 1,863 QA pairs built from thousands of Wikipedia articles and Wikimedia images, designed to systematically evaluate multimodal retrieval and reasoning in retrieval-augmented generation.
